description: CloudWatch Insights queries optimized for visual dashboard widgets. Each query includes the recommended widget type and title for CloudWatch Dashboard deployment.

overview.title: Environment Lifecycle Overview (per hour)
overview.description: Cold starts, shutdowns, and total invocations per hour. Use three separate queries overlaid on the same widget.

queries.cold_starts: filter Environment = 1 | stats count(*) as ColdStarts by bin(1h)
queries.shutdowns: filter Shutdowns = 1 | stats count(*) as Shutdowns by bin(1h)
queries.invocations: filter Invokes = 1 | stats count(*) as Invocations by bin(1h)

overview.title: Shutdown Speed Distribution
overview.description: Proportion of fast, medium, and slow shutdowns.
overview.query: filter Shutdowns = 1 | fields if(TotalLifetime < 180000, 'Fast (< 3 min)', if(TotalLifetime < 600000, 'Medium (3-10 min)', 'Slow (> 10 min)')) as ShutdownSpeed | stats count(*) as envCount by ShutdownSpeed

overview.title: Shutdown Reasons
overview.description: Distribution of shutdown reasons (SPINDOWN, TIMEOUT, FAILURE).
overview.query: filter Shutdowns = 1 | stats count(*) as envCount by @properties.ShutdownReason as ShutdownReason

overview.title: Cold Start Rate Over Time
overview.description: Cold starts per 5-minute window. Shows when cold starts spike.
overview.query: filter Environment = 1 | stats count(*) as ColdStarts by bin(5m)

shutdown_patterns.title: Environment Lifetime Distribution
shutdown_patterns.description: Histogram of environment lifetimes in minute buckets.
shutdown_patterns.query: filter Shutdowns = 1 | fields TotalLifetime / 1000 / 60 as lifetimeMinutes | fields if(lifetimeMinutes < 1, '00-01 min', if(lifetimeMinutes < 2, '01-02 min', if(lifetimeMinutes < 3, '02-03 min', if(lifetimeMinutes < 5, '03-05 min', if(lifetimeMinutes < 10, '05-10 min', if(lifetimeMinutes < 15, '10-15 min', '15+ min')))))) as LifetimeBucket | stats count(*) as envCount by LifetimeBucket

shutdown_patterns.title: Shutdown Lapse (Time After Last Invoke)
shutdown_patterns.description: How long Lambda waits after the last invocation before shutting down. Trend over time.
shutdown_patterns.query: filter Shutdowns = 1 | fields ShutdownLapse / 1000 as shutdownLapseSec | stats avg(shutdownLapseSec) as AvgShutdownLapseSec, percentile(shutdownLapseSec, 50) as P50, percentile(shutdownLapseSec, 90) as P90 by bin(1h)

shutdown_patterns.title: Invocations vs Lifetime (per environment)
shutdown_patterns.description: Shows each environment's invoke count against its lifetime. Use as a table or export for scatter plot.
shutdown_patterns.query: filter Shutdowns = 1 | fields @properties.ExtensionId as EnvId, TotalInvokes, TotalLifetime / 1000 / 60 as LifetimeMin, @properties.ShutdownReason as Reason, AvgIdleGap / 1000 as AvgIdleGapSec | sort TotalLifetime desc | limit 100

shutdown_patterns.title: Shutdowns by Hour of Day (UTC)
shutdown_patterns.description: When do shutdowns happen? Identifies time-of-day patterns.
shutdown_patterns.query: filter Shutdowns = 1 | stats count(*) as Shutdowns, avg(TotalLifetime) / 1000 / 60 as AvgLifetimeMin by @properties.HourOfDay as HourUTC | sort HourUTC asc

traffic_analysis.title: Traffic Drop Rate vs Avg Lifetime
traffic_analysis.description: Environments grouped by traffic drop severity, showing average lifetime per group.
traffic_analysis.query: filter Shutdowns = 1 | fields if(TrafficDropRate < 25, '1. Low (<25%)', if(TrafficDropRate < 50, '2. Moderate (25-50%)', if(TrafficDropRate < 75, '3. High (50-75%)', '4. Severe (>75%)'))) as TrafficDrop | stats count(*) as EnvCount, avg(TotalLifetime) / 1000 / 60 as AvgLifetimeMin, avg(TotalInvokes) as AvgInvokes by TrafficDrop

traffic_analysis.title: Invocation Rate Trend
traffic_analysis.description: Invocations per minute over time. Shows traffic patterns that precede shutdowns.
traffic_analysis.query: filter Invokes = 1 | stats count(*) as InvocationsPerMin by bin(1m)

traffic_analysis.title: Peak RPM Distribution Across Environments
traffic_analysis.description: How peak traffic varies across environments. Helps size provisioned concurrency.
traffic_analysis.query: filter Shutdowns = 1 | fields if(PeakRequestsPerMinute <= 5, '1. 1-5 RPM', if(PeakRequestsPerMinute <= 15, '2. 6-15 RPM', if(PeakRequestsPerMinute <= 30, '3. 16-30 RPM', '4. 30+ RPM'))) as PeakRPMBucket | stats count(*) as EnvCount by PeakRPMBucket

resource_utilization.title: Memory Utilization Per Invocation
resource_utilization.description: Per-invocation memory utilization trend. Shows if memory pressure builds over time.
resource_utilization.query: filter Invokes = 1 and MemoryUtilizationPct > 0 | stats avg(MemoryUtilizationPct) as AvgMemUtil, max(MemoryUtilizationPct) as MaxMemUtil, percentile(MemoryUtilizationPct, 90) as P90MemUtil by bin(5m)

resource_utilization.title: Memory Utilization vs Shutdown Speed
resource_utilization.description: Average memory utilization grouped by shutdown speed category.
resource_utilization.query: filter Shutdowns = 1 | fields if(TotalLifetime < 180000, 'Fast (< 3 min)', if(TotalLifetime < 600000, 'Medium (3-10 min)', 'Slow (> 10 min)')) as ShutdownSpeed | stats count(*) as EnvCount, avg(AvgMemoryUtilizationPct) as AvgMemUtil, avg(MaxMemoryUtilizationPct) as AvgMaxMemUtil by ShutdownSpeed

resource_utilization.title: Billed Duration Per Invocation
resource_utilization.query: filter Invokes = 1 and BilledDuration > 0 | stats avg(BilledDuration) as AvgDuration, percentile(BilledDuration, 50) as P50, percentile(BilledDuration, 90) as P90, percentile(BilledDuration, 99) as P99 by bin(5m)

idle_patterns.title: Idle Gap Distribution
idle_patterns.description: Histogram of idle gaps between invocations. Key for determining keep-alive ping interval.
idle_patterns.query: filter Invokes = 1 and IdleGap >= 0 | fields IdleGap / 1000 as idleGapSec | fields if(idleGapSec < 1, '1. < 1s', if(idleGapSec < 5, '2. 1-5s', if(idleGapSec < 15, '3. 5-15s', if(idleGapSec < 30, '4. 15-30s', if(idleGapSec < 60, '5. 30-60s', if(idleGapSec < 120, '6. 1-2 min', '7. 2+ min')))))) as IdleGapBucket | stats count(*) as occurrences by IdleGapBucket

idle_patterns.title: Idle Gap Trend Over Time
idle_patterns.description: Average and P90 idle gap over time. Shows if invocation spacing is changing.
idle_patterns.query: filter Invokes = 1 and IdleGap >= 0 | stats avg(IdleGap) / 1000 as AvgIdleGapSec, percentile(IdleGap / 1000, 50) as P50Sec, percentile(IdleGap / 1000, 90) as P90Sec by bin(5m)

idle_patterns.title: Avg Idle Gap vs Shutdown Speed
idle_patterns.description: How average idle gap correlates with environment lifetime.
idle_patterns.query: filter Shutdowns = 1 | fields if(TotalLifetime < 180000, 'Fast (< 3 min)', if(TotalLifetime < 600000, 'Medium (3-10 min)', 'Slow (> 10 min)')) as ShutdownSpeed | stats count(*) as EnvCount, avg(AvgIdleGap) / 1000 as AvgIdleGapSec, avg(TotalInvokes) as AvgInvokes by ShutdownSpeed

cold_start_analysis.title: Cold Start Overhead Over Time
cold_start_analysis.description: Cold start overhead (init duration + init-to-first-invoke) trend.
cold_start_analysis.query: filter Shutdowns = 1 and IsColdStart = 1 | stats avg(ColdStartOverhead) as AvgOverheadMs, avg(InitDuration) as AvgInitMs, avg(InitToFirstInvoke) as AvgInitToInvokeMs by bin(1h)

cold_start_analysis.title: Cold Starts and Shutdowns Timeline
cold_start_analysis.description: Overlaid cold starts and shutdowns per 5-minute window. Visual correlation of churn. Use two queries overlaid on the same widget.

queries.cold_starts: filter Environment = 1 | stats count(*) as ColdStarts by bin(5m)
queries.shutdowns: filter Shutdowns = 1 | stats count(*) as Shutdowns by bin(5m)

cold_start_analysis.title: Environment Churn Rate
cold_start_analysis.description: Cold starts and shutdowns per hour side by side. Ratio close to 1.0 means every shutdown triggers a new cold start. Compute churnRatio = coldStarts / shutdowns from the two query results.

queries.cold_starts: filter Environment = 1 | stats count(*) as coldStarts by bin(1h)
queries.shutdowns: filter Shutdowns = 1 | stats count(*) as shutdowns by bin(1h)

cost_estimation.title: Cold Start Cost Impact Summary
cost_estimation.description: Aggregated data for estimating cold start cost: total cold starts, avg overhead, total wasted compute time.
cost_estimation.query: filter Shutdowns = 1 | stats count(*) as totalShutdowns, sum(IsColdStart) as totalColdStarts, avg(ColdStartOverhead) as avgColdStartOverheadMs, sum(ColdStartOverhead) / 1000 as totalColdStartOverheadSec, avg(AllocatedMemory) as avgMemoryMB, avg(TotalInvokes) as avgInvokesPerEnv, avg(TotalLifetime) / 1000 / 60 as avgLifetimeMin

cost_estimation.title: Provisioned Concurrency Sizing Data
cost_estimation.description: Peak concurrent demand estimation for provisioned concurrency sizing.
cost_estimation.query: filter Shutdowns = 1 | stats max(PeakRequestsPerMinute) as overallPeakRPM, avg(PeakRequestsPerMinute) as avgPeakRPM, percentile(PeakRequestsPerMinute, 90) as p90PeakRPM, avg(AvgBilledDuration) as avgDurationMs, avg(InvokeRate) as avgInvokeRate, count(*) as totalEnvironments, avg(AllocatedMemory) as memoryMB

cost_estimation.title: Keep-Alive Interval Estimation Data
cost_estimation.description: Idle gap and shutdown lapse statistics for determining optimal keep-alive ping interval.
cost_estimation.query: filter Shutdowns = 1 and @properties.ShutdownReason = 'SPINDOWN' | stats count(*) as spindownCount, avg(AvgIdleGap) / 1000 as avgIdleGapSec, percentile(AvgIdleGap / 1000, 50) as p50IdleGapSec, percentile(AvgIdleGap / 1000, 90) as p90IdleGapSec, avg(ShutdownLapse) / 1000 as avgShutdownLapseSec, percentile(ShutdownLapse / 1000, 10) as p10ShutdownLapseSec, percentile(ShutdownLapse / 1000, 50) as p50ShutdownLapseSec
